name: Curated Colors
description: Provides reusable color palettes and a color picker field that works with standard Drupal entities and Drupal Canvas components.

suggests.drupal/canvas: Enables the swatch picker inside Canvas's component editor for SDC props annotated with x-curated-color-palette.

project_description: Curated Colors replaces free-form color inputs and hardcoded color select lists with a visual swatch picker backed by named, exportable palettes. A palette is a config entity (curated_color_palette) holding an ordered list of colors, each with a stable machine key, a human label, an optional hex value and an optional custom CSS string (for gradients), organized into optional named groups. The curated_color field type stores a single color key from a chosen palette and exposes computed hex/style/label/css properties for use in Twig, Views and SDC props. A swatch picker widget replaces the plain select, the same picker is available as a standalone Form API element (#type curated_color_picker), and two formatters render either a swatch chip or a raw value. Because content stores the key (brand-blue), not the value (#0678be), the recommended pattern keeps actual color values in your stylesheet so brand changes are CSS edits, not content migrations. With Drupal Canvas installed, any SDC string prop annotated with the x-curated-color-palette vendor extension gets the swatch picker in the component editor. An example submodule (curated_colors_example) ships a Drupal Brand palette and a working colored_card SDC component demonstrating the CSS-class pattern.
